'];
let lastGrowthRenderKey=null;
let toastTimer=null;

function savingsMilestoneCount(){return [10000,30000,50000,100000,300000,500000,1000000].filter(v=>(Number(data.savings)||0)>=v).length}
function resolvedEmergencyDays(){
  const days=new Set();
  for(const e of data.urgeEvents||[]){
    if(!e?.resolvedAt||!e?.startedAt)continue;
    const d=new Date(e.startedAt);if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))continue;
    days.add(ymd(operationalDate(d,data.settings.dayResetHour??4)));
  }
  return days.size;
}
function growthProfile(){
  const clean=getCleanDays();
  const uber=Object.values(data.days).filter(d=>(Number(d.deliveries)||0)>=Number(data.settings.dailyTarget)).length;
  const emergency=resolvedEmergencyDays();
  const ps=paymentStats(),milestones=savingsMilestoneCount();
  const currentXp=clean*10+uber*5+emergency*20+ps.paidOnTime*15+ps.allImprovements.length*20+milestones*30;
  const xp=Math.max(Number(data.growthPeakXp)||0,currentXp);
  if(xp!==Number(data.growthPeakXp||0)){data.growthPeakXp=xp;storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(data))}
  const stageIndex=Math.max(0,GROWTH_STAGES.findLastIndex(x=>xp>=x.min));
  const stage=GROWTH_STAGES[stageIndex],next=GROWTH_STAGES[stageIndex+1]||null;
  const level=stageIndex+1;
  const stageSpan=next?Math.max(1,next.min-stage.min):Math.max(1,stage.min-(GROWTH_STAGES[stageIndex-1]?.min||0));
  const stageProgress=clamp((xp-stage.min)/stageSpan,0,1);
  const subIndex=Math.min(2,Math.floor(stageProgress*3));
  const roman=['I','II','III'][subIndex];
  const title=stage.titles[subIndex];
  const pct=stageProgress*100;
  const backgroundIndex=Math.min(5,Math.floor(stageIndex/2));
  const finalEnd=stage.min+stageSpan;
  const nextUnlockXp=subIndex===0?Math.ceil(stage.min+stageSpan/3):subIndex===1?Math.ceil(stage.min+stageSpan*2/3):(next?next.min:finalEnd);
  const nextUnlockLabel=(!next&&stageProgress>=1)?'SEASON 1 COMPLETE':subIndex<2?`次の称号まで ${Math.max(0,nextUnlockXp-xp)}`:next?`次の大進化まで ${Math.max(0,next.min-xp)}`:`最終到達まで ${Math.max(0,finalEnd-xp)}`;
  const titleRemain=Math.max(0,nextUnlockXp-xp);
  const evolutionXp=next?next.min:finalEnd;
  const evolutionRemain=Math.max(0,evolutionXp-xp);
  const nextTitleLabel=(!next&&stageProgress>=1)?'SEASON 1 COMPLETE':subIndex===0?`${stage.stage} II`:subIndex===1?`${stage.stage} III`:next?`${next.stage} I`:'NOVA COMPLETE';
  const nextEvolutionLabel=next?`Lv.${level+1} ${next.stage}`:'Lv.12 NOVA MAX';
  const standardDailyGain=15;
  const todayRec=data.days[appDayKey()]||{};
  const cleanGain=(!todayRec.lapse&&!todayRec.clean)?10:0;
  const uberGain=(Number(todayRec.deliveries)||0)<Number(data.settings.dailyTarget)?5:0;
  const todayBaseGain=cleanGain+uberGain;
  const titleDays=titleRemain?Math.ceil(titleRemain/standardDailyGain):0;
  const evolutionDays=evolutionRemain?Math.ceil(evolutionRemain/standardDailyGain):0;
  return {xp,currentXp,clean,uber,emergency,paidOnTime:ps.paidOnTime,improvements:ps.currentImprovements,allImprovements:ps.allImprovements,stageIndex,stage,next,level,pct,subIndex,roman,title,backgroundIndex,nextUnlockLabel,titleRemain,evolutionRemain,nextTitleLabel,nextEvolutionLabel,todayBaseGain,cleanGain,uberGain,titleDays,evolutionDays};
}
function setImg(el,src){
  if(!el)return;
  if(el.dataset.src===src)return;
  el.dataset.src=src;
  el.classList.remove('asset-failed');
  el.onerror=()=>el.classList.add('asset-failed');
  el.onload=()=>el.classList.remove('asset-failed');
  el.src=src;
}
function showAchievement(kicker,title,body,imgSrc){
  const toast=document.getElementById('achievementToast');if(!toast)return;
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toast.innerHTML=`${imgSrc?`<img src="${imgSrc}" alt="">`:''}<div class="a-copy"><div class="a-kicker">${kicker}</div><strong>${title}</strong><span>${body}</span></div>`;
  toast.classList.remove('hidden');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>toast.classList.add('show'));
  toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{toast.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.add('hidden'),260)},3200);
}
function renderGrowth(){
  const g=growthProfile();
  const stageLabel=`${g.stage.stage} ${g.roman}`;
  const charSrc=`${CHARACTER_BASE}${g.stage.character}`;
  const bgSrc=`${BACKGROUND_BASE}${BACKGROUND_FILES[g.backgroundIndex]}`;
  document.getElementById('growthLevel').textContent=g.level;
  document.getElementById('growthStage').textContent=stageLabel;
  document.getElementById('growthTitle').textContent=g.title;
  document.getElementById('growthXpLabel').textContent=`${g.xp} GROWTH`;
  document.getElementById('growthNextLabel').textContent=g.nextUnlockLabel;
  document.getElementById('growthProgress').style.width=`${g.pct}%`;
  document.getElementById('growthClean').textContent=`${g.clean}日`;
  document.getElementById('growthUber').textContent=`${g.uber}日`;
  document.getElementById('growthPay').textContent=`${g.paidOnTime}件`;
  document.getElementById('growthEmergency').textContent=`${g.emergency}日`;
  setImg(document.getElementById('growthMiniCharacter'),charSrc);
  setImg(document.getElementById('growthCharacter'),charSrc);
  setImg(document.getElementById('growthBackground'),bgSrc);

  document.getElementById('heroGrowthLevel').textContent=`Lv.${g.level}`;
  document.getElementById('heroGrowthStage').textContent=stageLabel;
  document.getElementById('heroGrowthTitle').textContent=g.title;
  document.getElementById('heroGrowthXpLabel').textContent=`${g.xp} GROWTH`;
  document.getElementById('heroGrowthNextLabel').textContent=g.nextTitleLabel==='SEASON 1 COMPLETE'?'SEASON 1 COMPLETE':`NEXT ${g.nextTitleLabel}`;
  document.getElementById('heroGrowthProgress').style.width=`${g.pct}%`;
  document.getElementById('heroNextTitleName').textContent=g.nextTitleLabel;
  document.getElementById('heroNextTitleRemain').textContent=g.titleRemain?`あと ${g.titleRemain} GROWTH ・ 基本ペース約${g.titleDays}日`:'達成';
  document.getElementById('heroNextEvolutionName').textContent=g.nextEvolutionLabel;
  document.getElementById('heroNextEvolutionRemain').textContent=g.evolutionRemain?`あと ${g.evolutionRemain} GROWTH ・ 基本ペース約${g.evolutionDays}日`:'最終到達';
  const todayBits=[];
  if(g.cleanGain)todayBits.push('今日を守り切る +10');
  if(g.uberGain)todayBits.push(`Uber ${data.settings.dailyTarget}件 +5`);
  document.getElementById('heroGrowthMotivation').textContent=todayBits.length?`今日の伸びしろ：${todayBits.join(' / ')} ＝ 最大 +${g.todayBaseGain} GROWTH`:'今日の基本GROWTHは獲得済み。支払い前倒し・衝動回避・貯金到達でも伸びます。';

  const msg=g.currentXp<g.xp?(g.next?`最高到達 ${g.xp} GROWTHを保持。支払いなどで残高が動いても、成長段階は退化しません。`:`最高到達 ${g.xp} GROWTH。積み上げた成長は退化しません。`):(g.next?`「${g.title}」。次の大進化 ${g.next.stage} まで、現実の行動を積み上げる。`:'90日後も成長ログは続きます。次は生活基盤を維持して自由を増やす段階。');
  document.getElementById('growthMessage').textContent=msg;

  const track=document.getElementById('growthTrack');track.innerHTML='';
  GROWTH_STAGES.forEach((st,i)=>{
    const node=document.createElement('div');
    node.className=`growth-node${i<=g.stageIndex?' unlocked':''}${i===g.stageIndex?' current':''}`;
    const label=i===g.stageIndex?`${st.stage} ${g.roman}`:st.stage;
    node.innerHTML=`<span class="n">Lv.${i+1}</span><span class="s">${label}</span>`;
    track.appendChild(node);
  });

  const note=document.getElementById('paymentGrowthNote');
  if(g.improvements.length){
    const best=g.improvements.reduce((a,b)=>(b.delta||0)>(a.delta||0)?b:a,g.improvements[0]);
    note.textContent=`今月の支払い改善 ${g.improvements.length}件。最高は前回より${best.delta}日早い。`;
  }else{
    const prev=data.payments[previousMonthKey()]||[];
    note.textContent=prev.length?'今月はまだ「前回より早い支払い」の記録なし。1件でも前倒しできれば成長として残ります。':'支払い比較は、同じ毎月項目の支払い実績が2回以上たまると自動で始まります。';
  }

  const key=`${g.level}-${g.subIndex}`;
  if(lastGrowthRenderKey!==null&&key!==lastGrowthRenderKey){
    const prevLevel=Number(lastGrowthRenderKey.split('-')[0]);
    document.getElementById('heroCard')?.classList.add('evolving');
    setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('heroCard')?.classList.remove('evolving'),1200);
    showAchievement(prevLevel!==g.level?'EVOLUTION':'TITLE UNLOCKED',prevLevel!==g.level?`Lv.${g.level} ${g.stage.stage}`:`${g.stage.stage} ${g.roman}`,g.title,charSrc);
  }
  lastGrowthRenderKey=key;
}

function renderAll(){
  const t=ensureToday();
  const ad=appDate(),cut=Number(data.settings.dayResetHour)||0;
  document.getElementById('todayDate').textContent=`${ad.toLocaleDateString('ja-JP',{month:'short',day:'numeric',weekday:'short'})} ・ ${String(cut).padStart(2,'0')}:00切替`; 
  renderGrowth();
  renderHero(t);
  renderUber(t);
  renderPayments();
  renderSavings();
  renderChallenge();
  renderBackupState();
}

function renderHero(t){
  const streak=getCurrentStreak(),clean=getCleanDays(),day=getChallengeDay();
  const hero=document.getElementById('heroCard'),dot=document.getElementById('statusDot'),label=document.getElementById('heroStateLabel');
  const safeBtn=document.getElementById('safeTodayBtn'),urgeBtn=document.getElementById('urgeBtn'),hint=document.getElementById('heroHint'),command=document.getElementById('todayCommand');
  hero.classList.toggle('recovery',Boolean(t.lapse));
  dot.className='status-dot';
  safeBtn.disabled=false;

  let direct=Number(data.settings.gambleLoss),amount=protectedAmount();
  document.getElementById('avoidUber').textContent=money(data.settings.uberOpportunityLoss);
  const afterEl=document.getElementById('avoidAfter'),afterValue=Number(data.settings.afterImpactDays)*Number(data.settings.afterImpactPerDay);
  afterEl.textContent=afterValue?money(afterValue):'未設定';afterEl.classList.toggle('needs-setting',!afterValue);
  urgeBtn.textContent=t.lapse?'また行きたくなった':'今、ギャンブルに行きたい';

  if(t.lapse){
    direct=todayActualGambleLoss()||Number(data.settings.gambleLoss);
    amount=direct+Number(data.settings.uberOpportunityLoss)+Number(data.settings.afterImpactDays)*Number(data.settings.afterImpactPerDay);
    dot.classList.add('warn');
    label.textContent='RECOVERY — 追い金を止める';
    document.getElementById('shieldCaption').textContent='今日は損失をここで確定。追加損失を止める';
    safeBtn.textContent=t.recoverySecured?'✓ 追い金を止めた':'追い金せず今日を終える';
    safeBtn.disabled=Boolean(t.recoverySecured);
    hint.textContent=t.recoverySecured?'今日はここで終了。取り返しに行かず、次の日を0円から再開。':'負けを取り返す行動はしない。今日これ以上減らさないことだけを目標にする。';
    command.className='today-command danger-command';
    command.textContent=t.recoverySecured?'最優先：今日は追加で賭けない':'最優先：追い金を止める';
  }else if(t.clean){
    dot.classList.add('done');
    label.textContent=day<=data.settings.challengeDays?`NO GAMBLING — DAY ${day} / ${data.settings.challengeDays}`:`LIFE DEFENSE — DAY ${day}`;
    document.getElementById('shieldCaption').textContent='今日の防衛は完了。残したお金と生活を守る';
    safeBtn.textContent='✓ 今日を守った';
    safeBtn.disabled=true;
    hint.textContent='今日の記録は完了。明日はまた1日だけ守る。';
    command.className='today-command done-command';command.textContent='今日の最優先は完了。残したお金を守る。';
  }else if(t.pledged){
    label.textContent=day<=data.settings.challengeDays?`DEFENSE ACTIVE — DAY ${day} / ${data.settings.challengeDays}`:`DEFENSE ACTIVE — DAY ${day}`;
    document.getElementById('shieldCaption').textContent='今日は賭けない。稼働と現金を守る';
    safeBtn.textContent='今日を守って終了';
    hint.textContent='1日を終える時に完了。途中で衝動が来たら赤いボタンを押す。';
    command.className='today-command';command.textContent=t.deliveries>=data.settings.dailyTarget?'次：今日を守って終了':t.deliveries>0?`次：Uber あと${Math.max(0,data.settings.dailyTarget-t.deliveries)}件`:'次：Uberを1件だけ始める';
  }else{
    label.textContent=day<=data.settings.challengeDays?`NO GAMBLING — DAY ${day} / ${data.settings.challengeDays}`:`LIFE DEFENSE — DAY ${day}`;
    document.getElementById('shieldCaption').textContent='今日ギャンブルをしないことで守る最低額';
    safeBtn.textContent='今日の防衛を開始';
    hint.textContent='最初に「今日の防衛を開始」。1日を終える時に同じボタンで完了します。';
    command.className='today-command';command.textContent='最優先：防衛開始 → Uberを1件';
  }

  document.getElementById('protectedAmount').textContent=money(amount);
  document.getElementById('avoidGamble').textContent=money(direct);
  document.getElementById('streakDays').textContent=`${streak}日`;
  document.getElementById('cleanDays').textContent=`${clean}日`;
  const mk=currentMonthKey(),monthPayments=ensureMonth(mk).filter(p=>{const due=paymentDueDateForMonth(p,mk);return !due||monthKey(due)===mk}),paidCount=monthPayments.filter(p=>p.paid).length;
  document.getElementById('heroUber').textContent=`${Number(t.deliveries)||0} / ${data.settings.dailyTarget}`;
  document.getElementById('heroPayment').textContent=`${paidCount} / ${monthPayments.length}`;
  document.getElementById('heroSavings').textContent=money(data.savings);
  document.getElementById('heroStreak').textContent=`${streak}日`;
  renderValueAlternatives(amount,t);
  const g=growthProfile();
  if(t.lapse){setImg(document.getElementById('growthCharacter'),`${EMERGENCY_BASE}data:image/webp;base64,
